_about: One model for every number (Hanli, 2026-10-15; design.md § Pacing and the economy). The rules read these through content.mjs (withBalance) — the 层 thresholds onto the ladder, the pay tables onto rewards, the cooldowns onto the rerun and the 饭桶 — and tools/balance.mjs simulates a light, a typical and a heavy player on them, day by day, printing days per 回; tests/balance.test.mjs holds the bands. Change a number here, run `node tools/balance.mjs`, and hand-play it on the live page.
_layers: The progress each step asks, by tier (ladder.json names the steps). 练气 counts from 零层 (0). Fitted by `node tools/balance.mjs --fit` to `model.target_days` for the typical player (the 层 a 回's stage quest holds him on); the 层 a rise jumps over sit between. 筑基 and above wait for 卷二.
_overflow_stretch: Hanli, 2026-10-15 (approved): a step up — the story's rise, a throw, or grinding the 回's cap allows — carries the 修为 over the last mark in whole, and the new step asks this share of it more (state.mjs stepUp, `state.stretch`): 100 over 一层's mark enters 二层 at 100/450, not 0/400. Grinders stay only somewhat ahead; nothing is held or lost.
_layer_pay: Hanli 2026-10-16 (option A): 修为 grows with the layer — a higher layer's beasts and practice give more. The routine tables named here (功课, a haunt's or pool's fight, 闭关) pay their 修为 times the layer's multiplier, by tier (state.mjs layerPayOf; tools/balance.mjs plays the same). The story's grants are never scaled. A smooth rise with no cliff (same day: a near-tripling between two layers reads as a glitch), front-loaded: 古六 holds him on 三层–四层 right after 古五's 二层, and a layer never costs less than the one below, so 三层–四层 must pay well above 二层 for 古六 to fit a week — the steepest step is 二→三 (×2), the rest a gentle climb to 3.6 at 九层. A geometric 1 → 3.6 left 古六 at 9.3 typical days. The price: 古五 runs a little fast (4.5 typical days, its band's low end lowered to 4.5 — `model.bands.except`), in keeping with 古一–古三 fast.
_pay: What each kind of thing pays at most (修为 `progress`, 灵石 `wealth`); a grant is capped by its table (rules/core.mjs pay). Was rewards.json `tables`. Hanli, 2026-10-15 (「让游戏修为和故事match」): 修为 comes from cultivation; chores pay 灵石. `labor` pays an errand of 杂役 (修为 0, design.md § Pacing), `gongke` the day's 功课 (the fixed real-life chore, 修为 20), `life` the day's pick (灵石 only), `once` 开府 (灵石 only). A natural day of 卷一 play is now ~138 修为 (功课 20, two pool fights 60, half a rumor ~38, a road-meet 20) and the 练气 thresholds ask a 回 of it per held layer (tools/xiuwei-model.mjs). The 2026-09-24 note below is history. 2026-10-16 (灵石 buys pills, and cards and gear after): a fight won at a haunt pays 15 灵石 (was 10); 功课 stays 修为 — a typical day ~49 in, ~36 to pills, a few hundred left at 卷一's end (tools/balance.mjs --wealth). 2026-10-22 (人间功课 as cultivation, worlds/jiuding/gongke.json): `chore_kind` caps what a chore's meaning adds on top of its own pay, `chore_week` the 宗门月俸.
_pay_stage: `stage` pays a 阶段任务 handed in (rules/gates.mjs stageTurn, Hanli 2026-10-16: 「七层圆满的任务大成了应该可以交任务拿奖励」). At 圆满 the 修为 cannot rise, so it pays 灵石: 60, three scenes' pay (`scene` 20) — about three days of the 回's 杂役 and 开府 — once per gate, never again; a gate crossed before stage quests paid is settled once on the next load (settleStages).
_convert: 圆满之后走剧情到下一个阶段; 刷副本或者打怪奖励的修为改为灵石 (Hanli, 2026-10-15). A grant on one of `tables` (a pool's or a haunt's fight, a 秘境 rerun's beast — never a scene, a board, the 功课, a rumor or a road-meet) pays 修为 only up to the full mark of the layer he may not step past (the 回's cap, or a realm's peak waiting on its cauldron); the rest is paid as 灵石 at `rate` per 修为 (rules/core.mjs pay), and never carries into the next layer. Default 1/3: a converted fight (30 修为 → 10, with its own 10 灵石) pays about one 杂役 errand (labor 20). The economy (tools/balance.mjs) owns the number.
_prices: Every shop price, one source (2026-10-16, Hanli: 灵石 buys pills): `buy` what a shop asks, `sell` what it gives back — folded onto items.json by content.mjs withBalance, so no item carries its own. 回春丹 15 and 回气丹 10: a typical day's 灵石 (tools/balance.mjs `--wealth`) buys two or three, and a pill eaten in a fight is gone.
_boards: Hanli 2026-10-16: a small game after 入门 pays 灵石 on its first clear only — plain 5, good 10, best (or all three 灵光) 15; a replay pays nothing. Before 入门 nothing is paid (state.mjs lockedOf shuts wealth). The rank: a task's `ranks` names it outright; else three stars is best, and of the listed marks the first (the clean clear) is best, the last plain, one between good; a board with no marks (洛书门, 小周天, the 今 boards) pays plain — a reading, not Hanli's word, to change here. On top of the task's own grant (rules/tasks.mjs boardPay).
_cooldowns: `pool_rest_min`: a pool beast beaten rests that long before the next stands (world.mjs poolResting; a pool may say its own `rest`). `rerun_h`: a 秘境's outer rooms open again that many hours after the last run ended (rules/rerun.mjs). `fantong_min`: after a feed the 饭桶 is full that long (rules/fantong.mjs). `shouchao_h`: 兽潮 comes again that many hours after the last night counted, at any hour (rules/shouchao.mjs; 2026-10-26, replacing the 酉时 window: about once a day, a little slack so the same time tomorrow is open).
_pills: 丹药 in the game (design.md § 丹药; story DESIGN § 六·五): every pill is `tier` (its 阶 — the realm it is for, a ladder tier id) and `zhuan` (一至九转) on items.json; a pill that pays 修为 names its `of` (the family, its 一转 一阶 pay in `base`), and content.mjs withBalance folds `effect.progress` = base × by_zhuan[转] × by_tier[阶], so no pill carries its own number. Tamed (Hanli: the story's ×9 a 转 and ×10 a 阶 are never the game's): 一转 ×1 · 三转 ×1.5 · 九转 ×3, a quarter more each 转 — the numbers the game already had (聚气丹 20, the 饭桶's 三转 30, the furnace's 九转 60) — and one 阶 adds one 一阶's worth. A pill eaten pays at most its table's cap (rewards tables), so the 九转 at 60 stands on the scene table's 60. Breakthrough pills (ladder.json breakthrough.pill.items) declare no `of`: the throw reads them by 转 (by_zhuan there); fight pills keep `effect.fight` (the 丹囊 bands).
_dandu: 丹毒 and 补转 (story DESIGN § 六·五: 下品吃多了积毒，体力上限一时降低，闭关可排；上品无毒；九转反能化毒). A 修为 pill eaten (服用 from the pouch, the 闭关 pill, a breakthrough's pill) leaves the turns its furnace left out owing: `owed` by 转 (一转 8 — the nine a 九转 has, less the one it got; 中品 四至六转 看体质, none in 卷一; 上品 none). Each turn owed takes `per_turn` off the 体力 pool's top, `cap` at most (state.mjs staminaMax). 闭关 is 补转 — the body makes up `cure_per_hour` turns an hour of any focus (rules/seclusion.mjs). A pill of `clears` 转 or more clears every turn owed. Fight pills (the 丹囊's 回春丹 · 回气丹) owe nothing for now (Hanli's call: 灵石 buys them, and 丹毒 there would tax the 灵石 once 体力 is on). With these numbers a 聚气丹 a day is made up by one hour's sitting; four at once stand at the cap until a night's 闭关.
_model: The players tools/balance.mjs plays, day by day (design.md § Pacing: ~30 minutes a day, one 回 a week; 古一–古三 fast). `minutes`: what each thing takes (a scene's passages read at `chars_per_min`). `players`: minutes a day (the first day longer), sittings, and what each does daily — `gongke` the share of days the 功课 is handed in, `reruns` 秘境 runs, `fights` pool fights, `fantong` feeds, `tale` 今日传闻s, `gate_fights` more pool fights while a stage quest waits, `seclude` hours of 闭关 a night (focus 修为: rewards.json seclusion's rate, the seclusion table's cap). `fight_win_rate`: a fight won (the 斗法 band, played again when lost). `fantong_progress`: a feed's 修为 on average (a pill now and then). `errands_at`: the 回 each errand that pays 修为 or a pill is done in (null: on no 卷一 map; tests/balance.test.mjs makes a new one name its 回). `fit`: the player and the days --fit aims the stage quests at (the heavy player: the one they hold back); `bands`: what the test holds, for the 回s from `later` on. Guesses to be hand-played on the live page (Hanli). `waking_h`: the waking day the sittings spread over, for 体力 — the model plays it ON (rewards.json stamina), as players will have it; while we test it is off (rules.mjs), and with these players it never binds.

bands._except: Since 2026-10-16 the story raises no layer: every 层 is ground. With `layer_pay` (修为 by the layer) every 回 from 古四 sits in the one typical band, 5–7.5 days — save 古五 (h07), allowed down to 4.5: the smooth curve keeps 二层 cheap so 古六's two layers fit (see `_layer_pay`). Lowered to 4 on 2026-10-16: the boards cut before 入门 (Hanli 「减少数量, 推动剧情」) shorten the opening, and 古五 lands 4.3 typical days. 2026-10-26: with the book's full text, 古四 (h05) reads 7.7 typical days and 古六 (h08) 10.1 — allowed to 8 and 10.5 until the new small games land and the 层 are re-fit (fit._hold).

fit._hold: 2026-10-20 (Hanli 「可以, 按你说的做」): 古七 (h11) holds 练气五–九层 at 1040…1120. After the 10-19 weak-board sweep the heavy player's 古七 is flat at 3.2 days from 960 to 1310, so its 3.7 target lands on the next step, 1390 — which puts the typical 古八 (h09) at 7.7 days, outside its 5–7.5 band. 1040 keeps every band and the old pace. 2026-10-26 (the book's full text played, Hanli 「你的建议我同意」): 古四–古六 (h05 · h07 · h08) hold 练气一–四层 at 470…530, the numbers before the change. Played whole, the book reads about twice as long; --fit would drop 一层 to 290 and still leave 古六 at 9.4 typical days. The re-fit waits for the new small games (doc/games.md § 全文后的小游戏) — Hanli's call.

model._pills: 灵石 out (2026-10-16): the pills a player carries into a fight and eats — `pills` per fight a player, bought at the mean shelf price of `pills_bought`, only with what he has (tools/balance.mjs --wealth prints the flow).
model._fit_days: 2026-10-16 (no story rise): 古四 (h05) 2 heavy days, 古五 (h07) 3, 古六 3, the rest 4.5 — 古四/古五 a little longer than before so the typical player is not through them in three days.
model._rerun: 2026-10-21 (design.md § Reruns): a 秘境 rerun's spoils in the model — its beasts' drops (rewards.json drop_tables, an elite's own odds), the 拾遗 find, the cache under it (chapter.json sealed.rerun), read by rules/rerun.mjs runsPay at a shop's `sell`. `found`: the share of runs whose 拾遗 (the short 守炉) is won; `three_stars`: of those, the share with the fire kept whole (the cache's grade); `sold`: the share of the spoils' worth turned into 灵石 — the rest worn, or fed to the 饭桶 (three things a feed). 鼎苔 sells for nothing: counted apart. 修为 is the beasts' alone, as before — the spoils never move a 回's days. Guesses, to be hand-played.

rerun._share: What tests/balance-rerun.test.mjs holds, for every player over the days a rerun stands open (`node tools/balance.mjs --wealth`). `xw`: the rerun's share of the day's 修为 — at most about half, so 功课, 闭关 and the story stay the clock (the story is the reward; Hanli 10-15, 30 min a day, one 回 a week), at least a quarter, so the 3 h slot is worth its 12 minutes (2026-10-21: light 48%, typical 37%, heavy 48%). `ls`: its share of the day's 灵石 — the typical player's one fight slot, and fights are where the model's 灵石 come from (杂役 and 开府 are not played), so most of it, never all (2026-10-21: 65%, 81%, 70%). `spoils`: a run's spoils at sell over its fights' own 灵石 — the drops and finds about as much as the fights, never far past (0.94).

_lock_fight: A story fight inside a key beat's lock (chapter.json `beats`, world.mjs lockOf) may be left once he is stuck (Hanli 2026-10-21: 「OK, a」): no shelf is reachable there, so a weak hand with an empty 丹囊 had no way past a 试. After `losses` fights of it lost or run dry, 「算了，往下走」 stands under its card (rules/skips.mjs fightStuck): the way on a win would take, paying nothing — no fight pay, no card, no drop, no exit grant — as a board left or a riddle passed.
